title: FIFA faces backlash over plan to sell stake in World Cup
summary: FIFA has proposed selling a stake in the World Cup to private investors, prompting criticism from UEFA and other football governing bodies. The proposal has been met with opposition from several countries, including Germany, which may stand up against it. FIFA's president Gianni Infantino has defended the plan, saying it will help reduce debt and increase revenue. However, critics argue that it could lead to the commercialization of football and undermine its integrity.
summary_points: FIFA proposes selling a stake in the World Cup to private investors
UEFA and other countries have expressed opposition to the plan
Germany may stand up against the proposal
FIFA's president Gianni Infantino has defended the plan as a way to reduce debt and increase revenue
Critics argue that the plan could lead to the commercialization of football
